question: Do they experiment with offering multiple candidate corrections and voting on the model output, since this seems highly likely to outperform a one-best correction?
title: Combating Adversarial Misspellings with Robust Word Recognition
answer_rationale: The evidence discusses perturbing words and counting unique predictions, but does not mention voting on multiple candidate corrections or comparing performance against a one-best correction. Therefore, it is not possible to determine whether they experiment with offering multiple candidate corrections and voting on the model output.
